page.layout: Two-column page with a running head and page number at the top. Left: a boxed table of names in groups, with years and symbols in the left margin beside the rows. Right: a narrow column of small-type annals. Below both, a full-width paragraph in small type that continues the right column.

main_text.l: [Ex his unam in consulatu obijsse exististimo.]
main_text.p: Fœdus nouum ci-vitatis cum Westergois, Ostergoo simile. Albertus Saxo militem sub præfectis diuersis in Frisiam mittit, ut eam at-terat.
* Foxus auspiciis Alberti Frisiam invadit, & in agrum Groning. venit.
Albertus Saxo a Cæsare Gubernator Frisiæ designatur.
† Albertus Saxo in Frisiam venit & homagium recipit.
Cum Groninganis colloquia instituit. Groningani Dammonam præsidio Edsardi munitam per Vlricum Dorn. tentant.
‡ Albertus e Misnia reuersus cum exercitu, filio obsidione Franekerae liberato, Groningam obsidet. Bellum pacatione dirimitur studio Georgij Thorcnij & Fri-

Roleff derici episc. Vlrajectus [?]. Albertus discedens Emdæ moritur. ‡ Edsardus Dammonam a Groninganis obsessam & oppugnatam cum clade corundem obsidione liberat. * Res ad inducias rursum studio Vlrajectini inter civitatem & Saxones ac Edsardum perductá.

page.notes: Layout: the year numbers and symbols (*, †, ‡) stand in the left margin beside the table rows; their exact row positions are approximate. The right-hand column is treated as main text because it is a narrow column of text, not a margin. The line "Roleff" sits slightly left of the right column's last line and is joined with it. The last word of the bottom paragraph, "Vlrajeff", is uncertain and may be "Vlrajectus", so it is marked. "Thorcnij" and "Roleff" are as printed. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed. The bottom paragraph's "=" marks in the scan are read as line-end hyphens.
